title: Focused cargo test runs skip the test-temp cleanup guard, so leaked test state surfaces only at the full gate
outcome: A focused `cargo test` run through the launcher applies the same test-temp cleanup guard as the full gate's rust-tests stage (scripts/test-temp-root.mjs), or reports clearly that it did not. A test that leaks its state root is then caught in the producer's focused GREEN rather than costing a full gate.
acceptance: A test shows that a focused cargo test run whose test leaves an entry in its run root reports the leftover and its creator, as the full gate does, and fails the same way; a clean focused run is unchanged.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
